title: mic_audio
description: Locator -> hub speech audio, sent ONLY while push-to-talk is active (LOCATOR_BRIEF.md section 2.4, section 8.5). Mono, 16-bit little-endian PCM. Chunks are 40 ms (640 samples at 16 kHz = 1280 bytes). Positioning continues during PTT; the beacon chirps stay audible in the speech audio on purpose (no speech-band filtering).

seq.description: Resets to 0 at each ptt start and increments by 1 per chunk.

sample_rate.description: Configurable; default 16000. Must equal what the hub expects for Cartesia STT — confirm with the other repo (section 2.4).

chunk_b64.description: Base64 of one PCM chunk. 40 ms at 16 kHz = 640 samples = 1280 bytes (1708 base64 chars).
